title: Prepared explosives; safety fuses; detonating fuses; percussion or detonating caps; igniters; electric detonators

review.classification: The June 2025 and October 2026 UNSD classifications preserve the original leaf. A documentary environmental account may select a sealed civil finished product within that leaf. An external packaging service or later redistribution alone cannot establish this product identity.
review.primary_evidence: The sector definition of first making available and the Commission Blue Guide distinguish the first external supply of a completed individual product, with or without payment, from a physical movement, a future order, a filing and a resale. Earliest manufacturing acceptance need not be located. Distinguish the verified original market event, identity, geography and documentary boundary of the complete unchanged product from a statistical quantity. Commercial product-level environmental declarations and programme guidance distinguish the product stage and document actual shared environmental attribution, subject to annual and programme scope. Impact scores alone do not provide an exchange inventory.
review.study_limits: First market eligibility, complete-product net kg and a compatible, properly scoped original environmental inventory are study data. The original reference basis and external package coverage have to be known. An estimated or rounded statistical mass, broader economic values, group statistics or a declaration based on a different packing convention cannot substitute. A missing study cohort may leave a particular model incomplete without disproving the existence of the method.
review.measurement_resources: Independent original ILCD reads verify the Mass property and kilogram group, and separately the Energy property and energy unit group. The energy unit supports 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ. A future purchased-electricity flow must retain the property and unit declared by its own qualified provider. These records supply measurement identities only.
review.independent_scope_and_measurement: A market event and a physical custody movement have independent documentary keys. One original opaque product-stage input and one output represent the same complete unchanged eligible product on the reconciled net-article basis. The mass denominator excludes external packaging while retaining its verified relevant covered burden once. A measured packaging movement is recorded in native units even when the remaining incremental burden is zero or its coverage is unknown. Component-level coverage requires evidence before an incremental addition. For a historic cohort of positive mass M, an evidenced ordinary exchange correction from E1 to E2 changes the original intensity by (E2-E1)/M even when current new placement is zero. A replacement supersedes E1; it cannot be added in full to the previous intensity. With no original mass, keep the correction in its native unit. None of these book entries reproduces the original product output. No study observations are inferred.
review.bilingual_and_projection: The two aligned documents contain five atomic exchange cards each. The final committed English and Chinese, and the canonical projection, carry the identity and coverage protocols, environmental programme identifiers, and the original-cohort correction. The focused check performed 28 checks with zero skipped and 3 disclosed quantity-range warnings.
review.readiness: Candidate authored environmental accounting method. Exact product and provider flow identities, exchange-level upstream coverage, original event and cohort evidence remain unresolved for a real dataset. Broader programme conformity, independent scientific approval, translation review and publication are separate.

sources.role: Frozen June 2025 UNSD PDF p. 173, classification coordinate only.
CPC3 row 1567 reconfirms the leaf and HS 2022 headings 3601–3603. The limited finished-product environmental scope requires evidence; category totals do not establish a lot.

Article 2(7)–(8) only. A real sector-specific first-market event; first making available on the Union market, commercially with or without payment. Not synonymous with dispatch, internal final acceptance, repeats or physical border crossing. This is an accounting boundary only.

2025 Commission evaluation Annex II methodology, note 167. The Commission independently evaluated actually sold civil production, including both EU and global markets. Supports relevance of external supply as a product boundary. Its aggregate value does not supply a target physical mass, lot, route, inventory or EU-only market share.

Statistical unit of measure, net mass. Reported goods net mass in kg excludes packaging. Use only for an in-scope record explicitly stating this basis, linked to the independent record of first external market placement. Customs declaration alone is insufficient. Packaging mass, net explosive content and gross weight are not the environmental product mass by default. No disassembly or physical tests implied.
2026 Eurostat user manual, net mass, around printed p.33. Some statistical records have rounded, estimated, or absent quantities. Missing or non-comparable mass leaves the study incomplete.

European Commission Blue Guide (2022), §2.3, OJ C247/20–21. Generic product-boundary explanation only.. The reporting event concerns each already manufactured individual item, once across the Union. A future order before completion does not qualify. A transfer may precede physical handover; separate actual stock/transport dates and charges from product placement. Establish an attributable finished item and matched net mass independently. This cross-sector guidance complements the sector definition and does not establish the ledger of a particular lot.

Regulation (EU) 2025/40, Article 3(1), point (1), and application date in Article 71; accounting definitions only. For periods from 12 August 2026, distinguish an integral part of a product from ordinary external material used to contain, protect, handle, present or deliver it. Record the documentary reference basis for the whole sealed finished article and each known external packaging component. Legal packaging categories alone do not identify a physical component of a particular product or its mass. Use matching nontechnical environmental declarations; no disassembly, handling protocol or technical design is required. Use then-applicable definitions for earlier study periods.

Environmental declarations NEPD-4019-3055-EN, environmental allocation p. 3; NEPD-9418-9023, allocation/data quality p. 4. Independent documentary examples of environmental attribution with separate identities and periods; use only screened environmental passages.
Programme register, NPCR 024:2021 v2.0 sections 6.2, 7.2.1–2 and 7.3.2. Declared environmental module boundaries only.
